description: This Java source file defines a class PreferenceServices that provides services to manage user preferences, including retrieval, storage, update, removal, copying, and grouping of preferences. It interacts with the database entities and utilizes utility classes for data conversion, validation, and messaging. The class handles preferences stored as key-value pairs, with support for groupings and default values.

classes.name: PreferenceServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing user preferences, including retrieval, storage, deletion, grouping, and copying of preferences within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves a single user preference based on userPrefTypeId and optional userPrefGroupTypeId for the current or specified user login.

methods.name: getUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group of user preferences for a given userPrefGroupTypeId, merging default values from properties if necessary.

methods.name: setUserPreference
methods.description: Stores or updates a single user preference value for a specific user, preference type, and optional group.

methods.name: removeUserPreference
methods.description: Removes a user preference entry for a given user and preference type.

methods.name: setUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Stores a group of user preferences for a user under a specified preference group type.

methods.name: copyUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Copies a group of user preferences from one user to another within the specified preference group.
